title: How To Get A Free Walmart Gift Card
description: http://www.johnchow.com On this episode of Driving with John Chow, I show you how to get a free Walmart gift card! I also compare the Jaguar F Type V8 S to the Corvette Z06 and explain why I went with the Jag.

asr.full_text: John Chow here from johnchow.com and welcome to driving with John Chow. I got a few more emails about this, my new car and one of the questions is why did I choose this one over the Corvette Z06? Because those were the two cars I was considering when I was looking for a new car. And I looked at both and I ended up with a Jag and I said no to the Corvette. So, you know, the question was why? You know, why? The Corvette was more powerful, it's even more powerful than this. This has 500 horsepower, the Corvette has 650 powerful it's even more powerful than this this has 500 horsepower the Corvette has 650 as lighter so it's always even faster and it's like a rocket that thing is super fast I mean they make this thing almost slow but why did I choose to jack over the Corvette a couple of reasons the first one is well I think this car looks better. I mean the Corvette looks good but this is at another level. It's like it's this is like I said before this is the most beautiful car on the road today. The second reason is the exhaust system. I mean the Corvette sounds nice, has a nice big American V8, makes a good rumble. This thing, the exhaust on this thing is ridiculous. It scares children, it scares little old ladies. It has so much sound. It crackles, it burps, yeah. The exhaust, this thing makes a fantastic noise. but the main reason I went with the Jag is not because of the car itself. it's because of the dealership. you see when I went looking to test drive these cars the Chevy dealership in Costa Mesa offered me a Walmart gift card for going for a test drive. Seriously, a Walmart gift card. I'm buying a $100,000 car, and you're giving me a Walmart gift card. I mean, it's fine to give me a gift card, but Walmart seriously that told me all I need to know about what the average Chevy driver is or what the dealership think the average Chevy driver is I mean Jaguar would never offer you a Walmart gift card so that there you go right there I mean I really think that maybe the Corvette should separate themselves from the Chevrolet brand because yeah I guess you have a Chevrolet driver and you're driving Impalas and whatever you know they can go for Walmart gift card but you're competing against cars like Mercedes, Porsche, Ferraris, seriously Walmart? Okay well that's that's there you go. SjohnChop and SjohnChop.com, thank you for listening, welcome your feedback, and if you want a Wal-Mart gift card, go check out the Chevy.
